title: PDU session reactivation result error cause

entities.name: PDU session reactivation result error cause
entities.description: Indicates the cause of failure to re-establish user-plane resources for PDU sessions during reactivation when included with the PDU session reactivation result IE.

entities.name: PDU session reactivation result
entities.description: Contains the result of PDU session reactivation procedures, indicating which sessions were successfully reactivated.

entities.name: Failed PDU session reactivation
entities.description: Condition where one or more PDU sessions cannot have their user-plane resources re-established during reactivation.

relations.description: The error cause IE is included conditionally when the PDU session reactivation result IE is present.
The error cause IE is included only if there are PDU sessions with failed user-plane resource re-establishment.
